title: Matched-control shallow PPO greedy fresh5k Slumbot gate
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The two-update Standard10-initialized matched control preserved the historical greedy execution contract while gaining enough general learned-anchor strength (+7.13 bb/100 versus Standard10 internally) to produce a positive fresh Slumbot point estimate without the degradation caused by the public-opponent treatment.
material_change: Freeze the completed matched-control checkpoint unchanged and evaluate greedy learned-logit execution for exactly eight independent fresh Slumbot sessions of 625 successful hands. No training, retry, session replacement, benchmark-specific action override, or checkpoint change.
baseline: Historical Standard10 greedy fresh20k -11.4275 bb/100 CI [-28.7124,5.8574]; actor-raw greedy fresh20k -46.5992; procedural soup fresh20k -41.8162.
notes: Preregistered promotion gate: fresh5k bb/100 > 0 and at least 4/8 session means > 0. Raw-hand normal CI and equal-session t7 CI are reported but are diagnostic at 5k. Promote only to a separate fresh20k; these hands never count toward the 100k qualification.

result.summary: Pre-session admission failed during pytest collection; zero Slumbot hands were attempted or completed.
result.conclusion: The orchestration wrapper omitted the local test_greedy_contract module required by test_pilot.py. This is a packaging failure, not policy evidence.
result.next_step: Start a distinct recovery experiment with the missing frozen test module included; retain the same checkpoint, preregistered gate, and new independent session seeds.
